visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with the bright interior of a retail store, showcasing the 'N+' and 'Nitori' logos. A prominent pink sign displays 'SALE MAX 50% OFF'. A mannequin stands to the right wearing a light blue turtleneck sweater. (2) The camera pans to a display of folded pants, primarily in black and navy. A close-up shows a price tag for 1,990 yen. The camera moves along rows of neatly stacked garments. (3) A hand reaches out to touch a pair of grey down pants. It flips over a tag featuring a duck icon and the Japanese text for 'Down'. The camera shows various colors like khaki and beige. (4) A large information board is shown, detailing different price tiers for down pants: 3,990, 4,990, and 5,990 yen. It includes illustrations of the garments' structure. (5) The shot shifts to mannequins dressed in complete outfits, including a grey cardigan with large buttons and a tan quilted jacket with a pink crossbody bag. (6) A hand inspects a dark grey cardigan on a hanger. The price tag indicates 2,990 yen with an additional '20% OFF' sticker attached. (7) Rows of light green puffer jackets are shown on a rack. The video concludes with a close-up of two mannequins in stylish autumn/winter wear. (8) A pink social media outro appears with various platform icons and the handle '@japanuts'.

(3) [Subtitle]: 意外發現 這裡居然有賣 羽絨褲. (4) [Subtitle]: 跟我之前在百貨公司買的 一模一樣 但價格只要一半 而且還很多顏色選擇. (5) [Logo]: 前面ダウンであたたか. [Subtitle]: 褲子內側 前面是羽絨、後面是刷毛. (6) [Slogan]: ￥3,990. [Subtitle]: 一件日幣3990含稅 共有4個尺寸. (7) [Subtitle]: 羽絨褲不只一款 分成三種，價格各不同. (8) [Subtitle]: 我是意外逛到他們店鋪 除了發現驚喜的羽絨褲外 還有很多女裝都很好看. (9) [Subtitle]: 雖然淺草店不大 但我也逛了好一陣子. (10) [Subtitle]: 餘光瞄到這件外套 覺得還蠻好看的. (11) [Subtitle]: 看了價格簡直驚呆 居然日幣2990再8折. [Slogan]: 20% OFF. (12) [Subtitle]: 這些價格就算沒折扣 也非常OK啊. (13) [Subtitle]: 你們下次快去逛逛 店鋪資訊在文字裡喔. (14) [Slogan]: 看更多資訊請點IG首頁連結. [Logo]: 日本失心瘋, japanuts.com, Q日本失心瘋俱樂部, @japanuts.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves to introduce and promote the 'N+' clothing brand by Nitori. It highlights the affordability and functional design of their women's apparel, specifically focusing on down-lined winter pants. By showing price tags and material details, the content creator aims to inform travelers to Japan about high-value bargain shopping options in Asakusa.
